items.goal: In CatalogApi.CreateItem (src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs ~L466), after BUG-17's ValidateRequiredFields check and before building the entity, reject a client-supplied Id that already exists with 409 Conflict ProblemDetails instead of letting Postgres raise a PK violation (500). alternatives.reason: The seeder inserts explicit ids without advancing the identity sequence, so a generated id would collide with seeded rows and still return 500.

alternatives.option: Catch DbUpdateException unique violation and map it to 409
alternatives.reason: Ties the API to Npgsql error codes and leaves a failed save behind. An explicit existence check is clearer.
